rules.rule: Prioritize correctness, fail-closed authority and privacy behavior, command or query injection, secret leakage, unsafe external I/O, race conditions, replay or idempotency failures, incomplete rollback/readback, and contract drift. Report only actionable defects on changed lines; preserve Agent 007 as designated writer and the APEX/JEOS boundary.

Check schema validity, fail-closed required fields and additionalProperties behavior, version and enum drift against runtime consumers, replay resistance, privacy classification, ownership, expiration, readback, and rollback semantics.
Check TOML validity and semantic drift across registries, lifecycle, routes, modes, namespaces, ownership, brain separation, least privilege, and designated-writer constraints.

Check least-privilege permissions, immutable action pinning, untrusted pull-request execution, secret exposure, shell injection, dependency provenance, and whether every reported green check actually executes the governed validation surface.
